max (sales): Aurelia Financial POC: UX team reports sporadic long first-byte delays in live demo. Typical TTFT ~90ms but occasional 600-1200ms spikes. Call in 20. Can ops triage?
rita (eng-runtime): On it. Which model/pool and region? Any sample traces or request IDs?
max (sales): Hosted eu-west, pool aurelia-demo-1, model redwood-chat-lite-quant. They pasted one trace snippet showing hold_timer_ms ~130 and prefix_cache_misses high. Also they hit a few 429s during a burst.
samir (eng-sre): Infra shows a short scaler rebound at 11:22 UTC then a prefix-shard rebalance -> some pods regressed to cold-cache backing store. Queue hold-time distribution has a tail at ~140ms. Looks like microbatch hold + cache misses stacking.
jaz (solutions): For quick mitigation: ask them to enable a 1-2 token client prefill and temporarily reduce client-side concurrency. That often smooths the UX. Also we can suggest a tiny warmup script if they move to Dedicated.
rita (eng-runtime): Operational quick fixes: set microbatch_hold_ms=8 (was 50), microbatch_max=10 for aurelia-demo-1, and enable prefix_cache_prefetch for the top 20 prefixes. This trades some throughput for lower TTFT. Want me to apply now?
max (sales): Apply. Also Aurelia asked about price delta for Dedicated and whether it eliminates these glitches.
olga (acct exec): Dedicated gives dedicated shards and less autoscaler churn; we can offer a 90-day pilot with 10% off list pricing and 4k demo credits. I'll DM the formal quote.
billing-bot: applied 4000 demo credits to aurelia@example.com @ 2310001125
samir (eng-sre): I'll pin min_replicas=2 for the demo window to avoid churn and add a one-off pod warmup job to prepopulate the prefix cache for their top prefixes. That should remove cold-cache misses after rollout.
rita (eng-runtime): For correlation, ask them to run this diagnostic and paste the JSON: ```curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-lite-quant","input":"<sample>","diag":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer | jq .diagnostics``` The diagnostics include hold_timer_ms, prefix_cache_hits/misses, and request_id.
jaz (solutions): I'll attach our SOC2/KMS summary and a short runbook with recommended prod configs and the warmup snippet.
max (sales): Aurelia pasted one trace line: {"req":"r-a11","hold_timer_ms":132,"prefix_cache_hits":1,"prefix_cache_misses":5,"model_ms":27}
rita (eng-runtime): That matches cold-prefix misses + hold time. After the config push expect hold_timer_ms <20ms; cache misses should drop after warmup. If it persists, fallback option: pin to a smaller quantized variant for the demo or allocate a warm-standby pool for the POC.
olga (acct exec): Note: reducing microbatch hold increases per-token cost slightly; for the POC we absorb demo delta in credits. We'll model production economics if they elect Dedicated.
max (sales): Rolling changes now and will update Aurelia on the call with the trace command and pilot offer. Thanks all :thumbsup:
